Order.title: Order
Order.description: A food or beverage order placed by a customer for delivery or pickup at CAFE 1911.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the order was created.

createdAtEpoch.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the order was placed.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the order status or notes were last modified.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the order.

customerName.description: Full name of the ordering customer.

contactNumber.description: Contact telephone number for courier delivery verification.

deliveryAddress.description: Physical destination address or salon collection indicator.

landmark.description: Optional gate code, cross street, or entry instructions.

orderNotes.description: Special dietary or preparation notes from the customer.

subtotal.description: Authoritative subtotal of items in Euros.

currency.description: Currency symbol used for the transaction.

isDemoOrder.description: Flag indicating simulated kitchen test order vs live restaurant order.

StoreSettings.title: StoreSettings
StoreSettings.description: Configurable operational settings for online ordering and courier dispatch.

isDeliveryActive.description: Toggle indicating whether delivery orders are currently accepted.

minOrderAmount.description: Minimum required subtotal to enable courier delivery.

currency.description: Active currency symbol for the store.

deliveryCoverageRadiusKm.description: Delivery radius in kilometers from salon.

email.description: Email address of the staff member.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Collection of customer food and beverage orders.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Authorized staff and admin accounts for salon dashboard access.
